purpose: Teach: ディスカウント/映し出さ/敬遠/すみやか/追随/係員/きめる/くらべ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ディスカウントセールを慎重に実施しろ
lines.en: We're running a discount sale, but I want us to be deliberate about it.
lines.style: Measured, authoritatively clear. Slight weight on 「慎重に」—deliberation matters. Calm command voice, no rush. Eye-level steady. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内モニターに業績が映し出される仕組みを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up the internal monitors so performance metrics are visible in real time.
lines.style: Efficient and responsive. Clean attack on the opening affirmative. Quiet confidence—he's already thinking through the logistics. Professional but not stiff. Natural pace, light at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合との直接対決を敬遠しろ
lines.en: And avoid a head-to-head battle with competitors. That's not our strategy.
lines.style: Firm, considered pause before 「敬遠しろ」. The weight of experience—he's saying don't do that because he knows what happens. Not aggressive. Quieter than the first line. Authoritative restraint.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。すみやかに対応致します
lines.en: Yes. We'll move on that right away.
lines.style: Quick, assured acknowledgment. No hesitation. He's already mentally noting what needs to happen. Clipped but respectful. The efficiency of trust between superior and dependable staff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の追随ではなく独自路線で行け
lines.en: Don't follow the industry trend. Find our own way.
lines.style: Decisive and slightly more forceful than the directional lines before it. Clear emphasis on independence. Deliberate pause after the first phrase. Expectant—he wants them to think differently.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。展示会の係員を増員します
lines.en: Understood. I'll increase staffing at the trade show to showcase that.
lines.style: Rapid-fire, action-oriented. Kenji is thinking ahead—he already knows which lever to pull. Upbeat, energetic. Confidence without arrogance. Slightly faster pace than before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、方針をきめる時は社員にも説明しろ
lines.en: One more thing—when we set policy, explain it to the staff. They need to know why.
lines.style: Softer opening. Less directive, more personal. A lesson, not a command. Slight warmth underneath the authority—he cares that they understand, not just comply. Measured, reflective pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。他社とくらべての強みを示します
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll make sure they see our competitive strengths and why we're taking this direction.
lines.style: Serious close. Kenji is locking in commitment—this is the synthesis of all the instructions above. Steady, thoughtful. Slight weight at the end, like a final agreement. Warm but formal.
